kebabKielce.lead: Szef Donald is a small kebab place at ul. Ks. Piotra Ściegiennego 68a in Kielce. We opened in 2019 and have made everything on site from day one — meat, salads and sauces are prepared every day, and we simply don't have a freezer. Below is everything worth knowing before you order: the meat, sizes with meat weights and prices, sauces, our other dishes, delivery, pickup and opening hours.

sections.heading: What makes our kebab in Kielce different
paragraphs: We are not a chain or a franchise. The people behind the counter are the same people who chop the vegetables, prepare the meat and mix the sauces in the morning. That means we know exactly what goes into every wrap, pita and bun — and we can stand behind it.

In season we serve around {wraps} wraps a week. That's a lot for a small place, but it's exactly this volume that lets us prepare the meat and salads fresh every day instead of storing them for weeks. A busy counter means a short time from preparation to your plate.
bullets: Made on site at Ściegiennego 68a — since 2019.
No freezer: what we prepare in the morning is served the same day.
Generous portions — the meat weight for every size is shown in the menu.
Three house sauces: mild, spicy and mixed.
A vegetarian option for those who don't eat meat: falafel.

sections.heading: How a Szef Donald kebab is made
paragraphs: The day starts with preparing the meat and chopping vegetables. The meat is roasted on a vertical spit and carved to order, just before serving — so it goes into your wrap warm, juicy and browned, not reheated. Salads are prepared throughout the day so they stay fresh and crunchy.

Every order is assembled only once it comes in. You choose the bread or serving style, the size, the meat and the sauce, and we add any extras you ask for — such as feta, cheese, fries or extra meat. Not a fan of salad? Choose the "Dutch" version, with fries instead of salad.

meat.heading: Meat: chicken, beef or mixed
paragraphs: The meat is the heart of a kebab, so we don't skimp on it or on the seasoning. Chicken is milder and lighter, beef has a deeper, richer flavour, and the mixed option combines the two if you can't decide.
meat.samePrice: The price doesn't depend on the meat — you pay for the portion size.

sauces.heading: Sauces: mild, spicy or mixed
sauces.choicePaid: With every kebab you choose one sauce: {sauces}. The sauce is required and costs {surcharge} — it is already included in the prices on this page and in the menu.
sauces.choiceFree: With every kebab you choose one sauce: {sauces}. The sauce is included in the price.
paragraphs: Mild is a creamy sauce for those who want to taste the meat first and foremost. Spicy has a clear, warming heat. Mixed combines both — a good choice for your first visit. If you like it really hot, say so in the order notes. You can add an extra portion of sauce from the extras.

dishes.heading: Not just kebab in a wrap
dishes.intro: The classics are kebab in a wrap, in pita and in a bun. If you'd rather eat with a fork or you're really hungry, try the other dishes on our menu:

items.heading: Kapsalon
items.text: A Dutch classic loved by the hungriest in Kielce: fries topped with kebab meat, cheese and sauce, all in one tray. The most filling dish on our menu.

items.heading: Fryto kebab
items.text: A kebab wrap with fries inside — meat, salad, fries and sauce rolled up together. A good pick when a regular wrap isn't enough and you don't want cutlery.

items.heading: Kebab box
items.text: Meat, fries and sauce in a handy box. Easy to take away or eat in the car, no bread.

items.heading: Kebab plate
items.text: A full meal: meat, fries, salad and sauce served on a plate. Eat in or take it away.

items.heading: Tacos
items.text: A tortilla with three chicken tenders, fries, cheese, iceberg lettuce and sauce — for those who prefer crispy chicken to classic kebab meat.

items.heading: Falafel
items.text: The vegetarian alternative: crispy falafel with lettuce and sauce, in a wrap, pita, bun or on a plate. You choose the number of pieces and the sauce, just like with kebab.

falafelKielce.lead: Looking for falafel in Kielce? At Szef Donald, ul. Ks. Piotra Ściegiennego 68a, falafel is a proper dish, not a side. We serve it in a tortilla wrap, in pita, in a bun or on a plate — with salad and your choice of sauce.

paragraphs: We make falafel at the restaurant during the day, like the rest of the menu — we have no freezer. Falafel dishes are vegetarian: no meat, so a good choice if you skip kebab or are ordering for a mixed group.
You choose the portion by the number of falafel pieces — from standard to Mega. Plus salad and a sauce: mild, spicy or mixed.
